{{short description|Luxembourg chemist, author, and politician (1957-2009)}}
'''Adri van Westerop''' (9 December 1957 – 23 December 2009) was a Luxembourg politician, author and scientist.<ref name="RTL"/><ref>Food, 1990</ref><ref>Thematic roundabouts, 1999</ref><ref>Forum for critical information, 1990</ref> She was born in [[Haarlem]], [[Netherlands]].<ref name="RTL">{{cite news |archivedate=3 July 2013 |date=27 December 2009 |archiveurl=https://archive.today/20130703025620/http://news.rtl.lu/news/national/53595.html |via=[[archive.is]] |publisher=RTL Télé Lëtzebuerg |url=http://news.rtl.lu/news/national/53595.html |title=Am Alter vun 52 Joer ass d'Adri van Westerop gestuerwen |language=Luxembourgish |trans-title=At the age of 52, Adri van Westerop died |access-date=2017-11-09 |url-status=dead }}</ref> She moved to Luxembourg in 1983 and became the first environmental counselor in 1997.

As an engaged [[environmentalist]], she set herself a more healthy and responsive life and sought to organize and broaden ecologically and socially responsible acts.<ref name="RTL"/> The following topics were of particular interest to van Westerop: healthy eating, ecological construction, environmental protection, retailers responsibility, fair trade, and solidarity with developing countries. In January 2011 she was awarded the 2010 Help for Nature Award.

She was active in the press and in the media, and on different radio stations.<ref name="RTL"/>

Adri van Westerop was married and mother of one child.<ref name="RTL"/>

Van Westerop died 23 December 2009 in [[Luxembourg City]], Luxembourg.<ref name="RTL"/>

==Politics==
Adri van Westerop was elected to the municipal council of [[Betzdorf, Luxembourg|Betzdorf]] in 1999.<ref name="RTL"/> She was president of two communal commissions: the Climate Change Commission (the Alliance for the Climate) and the Foreign Commission. She was involved in the Climate Alliance and [[LEADER programme]]. Adri van Westerop was a candidate for [[The Greens (Luxembourg)|the Greens]] for [[European elections]] - and for the Chamber elections.<ref name="RTL"/>
